summary: Canada Lookouts lists a British Columbia lookout named Dixon in Bulkley-Nechako at 55.182, -125.547. No history, status or access found.

evidence.supports: Dixon is listed among British Columbia lookouts
Entry gives coordinates 55.182 N, 125.547 W and elevation 1732 (no unit printed)

notes_for_editor: Single thin source: the Canada Lookouts entry gives only the BC heading, region, coordinates and elevation. No history, builder, status, agency or access was found in any source read. The story is about 60 words, well under the 120-word target; I did not pad it. The elevation (1732) has no unit on the page; the record treats it as metres, but it could be feet. The point is not within about 6 km of any federal gazetteer feature (the cached gazetteer holds mountains only). The cached Canada Lookouts annual-report page does not mention Dixon. Two web searches were run plus one extra (3 total, one over the per-tower budget). Only the one source is cited. A later pass could check BC Forest Service annual reports for a Dixon lookout entry. The page prints the coordinates without N, S, E or W signs, so the story's north and west come from the British Columbia location, not from the page.
